name: s81sl_xr1-s81sl_xr1-COMMIT
purpose: S81-SLICE control-plane sub-leaf ot_s81sl_xr1 to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81sl_xr1 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_xr.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81sl_xr1/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81sl_xr1/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81sl_xr1 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81sl_xr1  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-SLICE (stream 0cm, owner-approved DV p4): new control-plane sub-leaf (centre leaf, C1 master, 14 per die) of the distributed-vector slice; flop-first pins, die hold budget; pin-bound square outline (7.8k pins, <= 6/um on full faces). XR2 (10-17, after EARLY_FAIL_SETUP -611 ps / 9.3k endpoints of 1dd564c6f): classify stage (+1 cycle on CTL / RD / lo / V / SC) registers the source select, CTL payload, RD row pairs and decoded per-target / per-leaf enables before any wide write (was one cycle E/N pin flop -> 1.1k-bit select -> 5x1024 unpacker enables); keep port registers for c_d / is_d / cfg_d / rb_d (synthesis had folded 960 + 160 pins onto 160 + 32 flops driving W and N faces); fixed-index pk pair writes. OWNERS-S81/XR (10-18): ported onto RTL-BUILD-S81's xr (ENG collector e_*/eg_* -> xfin s, g_* gate fan-out, CTL target 1 x_mode/x_scale; +738 pins -> 8.6k) -- outline 432 x 518.4 (W face c/sw/e/g 2,850 pins on 505 um = 5.6/um, S + x_mode/x_scale/eg). XR3 (OWNERS-S81/XR2 10-18, after --cts gate 6fe7b4ea6 pin-flop spread TT 113 / FF 103 and gate ba880f813 TT 135 / FF 120 with the late flops (+80..+135 ps, 451 of 16.2k) on the S-face pin band and the SW / SE corners): c_d / rb_* / g_* single copies fanned out in ot_s81sl_slice glue (-908 pins), clk / rst_n ranged at the E-face centre, outline 345.6 x 432, explicit CTS sink clustering (size 24 / 30 um, distance_between_buffers 15, balance_levels) so the edge pin-band leaves hang off short leaf nets. XR4 (S81-SLICEP 10-18, after gate2 2cf382261 sink clustering FAIL TT 128 / FF 113, insertion 866): 16 per-region clock roots by 2-D k-means (physical/common_flow/clock_split_km.tcl, OT_CKKM_K 16: the pin-flop ring becomes 16 arcs / core masses of <= ~140 um, one BUFx24 local root at each centroid, CTS balances the roots), explicit cts_sink clustering dropped; io_hold_margin 0.025 (KITS rule 10-18). Same RTL, port, cycles, SDC.
